benefits.text:
BBIA Nudy Lip Pencil is a nude lip liner that helps define and slightly extend the lip line through a makeup effect, so lips look neater, softer and more natural.

Texture highlights:
- Soft, smooth pencil that glides comfortably over lips and blends easily.
- Grips lightly after blending, helping the lip line hold its shape longer.
- Lip-matching nude shades that blend easily into your natural lip color for a “natural lips, only prettier” effect.
- Smooth, light-matte finish with a soft-blur effect, without feeling dry or stiff.

Technology highlights:
- Water-lock fixing system helps form a thin film on the lip surface to hold color better.
- Flexible film fixing helps the pencil layer move with your lips, helping limit cracking/breaking of color in lip lines.
- After application, the oils gradually evaporate, leaving color, wax and a gel network that help the lip line look more defined and help limit smudging.

Pairing options:
- Can be used alone for natural nude lips.
- Can be used as a base layer or lip liner before applying lipstick.
- Suitable for layering with many lipstick textures, such as lip tints, matte lipsticks and lip glosses.

Easy-to-use design:
- Medium-thickness tip, easy to control when lining lips.
- Suitable even for beginners in lip makeup.

howToUse.text: Line lightly along your natural lip line, or extend the lip line slightly where you want to adjust it. Can be blended lightly with a fingertip/lip brush before applying lipstick. Use alone for natural nude lips or layer with other lip products.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.
